question: Why can this creation not properly be called the first creation?
premises: In this creation all portions of dissolution and creation abide in the middle.
A first creation would not contain dissolution and creation as intermediate portions within it.
Therefore it is not fitting to call this creation the first.
inference: Because dissolution and creation are both present within it as middle phases, this creation cannot rightly be designated as the primordial first creation.
plain_english: In that creation, all the aspects of dissolution and creation exist in the middle; therefore it would not be fitting to call it the very first creation.
